network_code.description:
Network code.

Conditions: if omitted, the currency default network will be
used

payment_id.description:
An additional recipient identifier (for example, "Memo") required for specific currencies.

ℹ️ Call `GET /public/currency/{currency}` and check `payout_is_payment_id` value to determine if a payment ID is needed.

include_fee.description:
Flag indicating whether fees will be included in the final amount of the resulting transaction.

Values:
  * `true`—fees will reduce the amount sent to the receiver. The amount written-off from the sender will be exactly equal to `amount`;
  * `false`—fees will increase the amount written-off from the sender. The amount sent to the receiver will be exactly equal to `amount`.

⚠️ If set to `true`, make sure that the amount exceeds fees.

ℹ️ Call `GET /wallet/crypto/fee/estimate` to get an estimated fee amount before creating a transaction.

auto_commit.description:
Flag indicating whether the sender should commit the transaction within 1 hour after it is created—the transaction will be rolled back otherwise.

Values:
  * `true`—one-phase scheme, the transaction will be committed automatically shortly after its creation;
  * `false`—two-phase scheme, the transaction must be committed or rolled back.

wallet_id.description: Wallet ID in an external network.

wallet_AmountCommon.title: Amount
wallet_AmountCommon.description:
The amount of the operation.

Format: currency precision

Values: > 0

ℹ️ Call `GET /public/currency/{currency}` to get the currency precision.

public_comment.description:
Custom text comment for external use.

ℹ️ The specified value will be displayed in the transaction history and may help in identification of the transaction.

ℹ️ Avoid the following characters: `&`, `'`, `<`, `>`, `"`.
